'''Mos Pelgo''' was a [[City/Legends|town]] located near the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> Sometime before [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the criminal organization known as the [[Dust Vipers]] conducted minor raids near its vicinity. Before the [[pirate]] [[Bel Nerodia]] took leadership of the Dust Vipers, the gang's most successful raid had been outside of Mos Pelgo, where they stole a dozen [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] that were en route to be scrapped.<ref name="SWTOR" />

In 3630 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Destruction of the Dust Vipers|destroyed]] the Dust Vipers after they raided an Alliance patrol and stole sensitive data. The Dust Vipers' activities near Mos Pelgo were included in the [[Alliance Intelligence (Eternal Alliance)|Alliance Intelligence]] post-mission report.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mos Pelgo was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. Mos Pelgo is only mentioned if the player completes the "Done and Dusted" Uprising.<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Freetown|Mos Pelgo]] originated in the [[canon]] continuity in ''[[Star Wars: The Aftermath Trilogy]]'' by [[Chuck Wendig]], where it was first mentioned in the first installment, [[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']], released in [[2015]],<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]</ref> before making its first appearance in [[2017]]'s ''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'', the final volume of the trilogy.<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref>
